text.zh: 你已是母队功勋。这时，豪门甩来一份天价合同……
text.en: You're a club legend now. Then a giant slides a blank-cheque contract across the table…

label.zh: 一人一城，名字刻进队史
label.en: One club, one life — carve your name into its history

note.zh: 致敬托蒂 / 马尔蒂尼

label.zh: 去赢冠军，职业生涯只有一次
label.en: Chase the trophies — you only get one career

label.zh: 周游列国，巴黎米兰曼联踢一遍、顺便放狂言
label.en: Tour the world — Paris, Milan, Manchester — dropping quotes everywhere

label.zh: 自由身赚一笔签字费，再想办法转回来
label.en: Leave on a free for the bonus, then angle to come back
